subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT-----C.INFO.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-41, on the page where Braxton names Charlie Parker's activity as 'the embodiment of the second transformation of black people in America' — the moment 'the affinity insight (1) principle' (the transformation/affirmation principle introduced on the previous page) emerged after WWII through bebop's relation to what white culture calls 'art music'. (C)TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is crossed with C-INFO (composite information): the question is how the thrust continuance of black creativity gets organized into composite information when AFI(1) has just been activated — i.e., how is Charlie Parker's transformation legible as composite information? The diagram is unusually compact for vol1 — only 6 nodes — suggesting Braxton wants the structural claim crisp. (C)MT-INFO (music information, doubly crossed) is the central hub: it feeds TH-CONT (the subject), RT-DY (reality dynamics), C-INFO (the crossing partner), and MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis). TH-CONT then solid-links to PRI-INFO (primary information). The structural argument: at the AFI(1) transformation moment, music information becomes the central organizing node — it simultaneously generates thrust continuance, reality dynamics, composite information, and the multi-informational degree basis, and only thrust continuance reaches primary information directly. The diagram is thus Braxton's specification of why bebop is structurally consequential: it puts music information into the *generative* position from which composite information, reality dynamics, and the degree-basis of further multi-information all derive.
